summary: Iter 165 — HR Attendance Plus enhancements (Summary page + exports, AI punch-machine import with Gemini, row-based bulk update, day-sheet in/out with auto OT, register select-all). Backend: 12/12 tests PASSED after fixing missing `Optional` import in attendance_bulk_router.py that was 500-ing the day-sheet POST. Frontend: Attendance Summary page, AI Import tab and HR Ops select-all render correctly with all required testids. CRITICAL FRONTEND BUG: Attendance Center Daily Sheet renders column headers for In/Out/Hrs/Remarks but does NOT render the corresponding <td> cells in each row — so ac-in-{id}, ac-out-{id}, ac-hrs-{id}, ac-remarks-{id} testids required by spec are missing (0 of 43 rows). Users cannot set in/out/remarks from the Daily Sheet UI even though the backend supports it.

minor.issue: DaySheetEntry model used Optional[str] but `Optional` was not imported in /app/backend/routers/attendance_bulk_router.py — every POST returned 500 (PydanticUserError: TypeAdapter not fully defined). FIXED by testing agent (added Optional to typing import).

ui_bugs.issue: Column headers 'In', 'Out', 'Hrs', 'Remarks' exist in <thead> but the <tbody> rows only render Code, Name, Designation, Status, OT, Approval — the In/Out/Hrs/Remarks <td>s are entirely missing. Result: 43 rows have 0 ac-in-*/ac-out-*/ac-hrs-*/ac-remarks-* testids. Users cannot enter punch times or remarks from Daily Sheet UI.

issues: React hydration warning: <span> is not a valid child of <option> (from ve-dynamic instrumentation in the project <select>). Non-blocking.

action_items: AttendanceCenter.jsx Daily Sheet rows: add <td> cells with Input for in_time (ac-in-{employee_id}), out_time (ac-out-{employee_id}), live Hrs display cell (ac-hrs-{employee_id}), and remarks input (ac-remarks-{employee_id}). Wire draft state to include in/out/remarks. Compute live Hrs from in/out and auto-fill OT (=max(0, hrs-8)) when overtime_hours is falsy — matches backend behaviour already verified.
Send in_time/out_time/remarks fields in the POST /hr2/attendance/bulk/day-sheet payload from the save() handler (backend already accepts them and computes hours/OT correctly).
(minor) In AttendanceCenter project select, avoid wrapping option text in <span> (fix instrumentation or use plain string) to remove hydration warning.
critical_code_review_comments: attendance_bulk_router.py used Optional in annotations without importing it — pydantic v2 raised runtime error on POST. Fixed. Consider adding a light backend smoke test for every new BaseModel to catch such issues.
AttendanceCenter Daily Sheet UI/spec drift: spec (and headers) promise In/Out/Hrs/Remarks per row but rendering only outputs OT + status. E1 likely trimmed the JSX during a merge.

attendance_plus_router._file_to_lines returns str(value) for non-datetime cells — dates from xlsx come as datetime already handled, but ints (like emp IDs) become '3.0' if stored as float in some files. Not blocking today with Gemini mapping.
attendance_plus_router.py is 750+ lines; consider splitting AI import lifecycle into its own module.

success_rate.frontend: 80% — critical Daily Sheet row rendering gap

seed_data_creation: Created 1 attendance row via day-sheet for Arjun Reddy on 2026-08-04 (P, 09:00-19:00, 10h, OT 2) — visible in HR Ops Attendance register. Row-based bulk upload also created/updated 1 attendance row for yesterday (E-1001). AI punch batch was created and rolled back within the same run (no residue).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend for attendance_plus + day-sheet is fully wired and verified. If main agent adds the missing In/Out/Hrs/Remarks cells to AttendanceCenter Daily Sheet, re-run test_iter165_attendance_plus.py to ensure nothing regresses and add a Playwright test that types into ac-in-{id}/ac-out-{id}, verifies ac-hrs-{id} shows the live sum, clicks ac-save, and reloads to confirm prefill. AI punch preview takes ~10-20s (Gemini). Clean-up: rollback deletes AI-imported attendance; bulk-rows created a real yesterday's row for E-1001 (marked 'iter165 test' remarks) — safe to leave as pending.
rca of the issue: 1) Day-sheet 500: `Optional` type hint used without import; pydantic v2 (2.13) resolves annotations at model build and raises PydanticUserError instead of NameError due to `from __future__ import annotations`. Repro: POST /api/hr2/attendance/bulk/day-sheet with in_time/out_time in any entry -> 500. Mitigation: added Optional to `from typing import ...`. 2) Daily Sheet missing cells: JSX in AttendanceCenter.jsx (lines 220-253) has <thead> declaring 10 columns but the row template only renders 6 <td>s (Code/Name/Designation/Status/OT/Approval). Add 4 <td>s (In input, Out input, computed Hrs, Remarks input) and mirror into `draft` state + save payload.
